name: WANTED: Baron Longshore
summary: On Ratchet's docks, Chief Engineer Gazlowe posts a bounty for Baron Longshore. The pirate captain hails from Gilneas and commands vessels of the Southsea Freebooters. His presence along the Merchant Coast threatens goblin merchant shipping across the region.

sections.title: Piracy on the Merchant Coast
sections.body: South of Ratchet, the Southsea Freebooters hold fortified camps along the Merchant Coast. Their pirates harass merchant vessels and disrupt the sea lanes the Steamwheedle Cartel relies on between Ratchet, Booty Bay, and points beyond. Under captains such as Baron Longshore, the raids drain the local goblin administration and threaten trade along the coast.

sections.title: A Captain from Gilneas
sections.body: Baron Longshore comes from Gilneas, the isolated human kingdom across the sea. On Kalimdor, he commands the pirate vessel Heedless and leads crews ashore just north of Northwatch Hold. Chief Engineer Gazlowe answers with a bounty, calling for Longshore's identifiable head.

faq.answer: Baron Longshore is a pirate captain from Gilneas who commands the Heedless for the Southsea Freebooters. He raids shipping lanes along the shore south of Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe want him dead?
faq.answer: Longshore's piracy threatens merchant shipping out of Ratchet. Gazlowe has placed a bounty on his head to protect trade and Steamwheedle profits.

faq.q: Where can Baron Longshore be found?
faq.answer: Baron Longshore frequents Southsea Freebooter camps along the Merchant Coast, south of Ratchet and just north of Northwatch Hold.

faq.q: What ship does Baron Longshore captain?
faq.answer: Baron Longshore captains the Heedless, a feared pirate ship on the open seas around the Merchant Coast.

faq.q: Is Baron Longshore an Alliance noble?
faq.answer: Baron Longshore bears the title of Baron and comes from Gilneas, but he leads the Southsea Freebooters as a renegade corsair, unaffiliated with the current Alliance leadership.

faq.q: Where is the bounty poster located?
faq.answer: The wanted poster hangs on the boards near the bank in Ratchet's port town.

angles.text: As a human, you can see how far deserters and outcasts from the Eastern Kingdoms have scattered across the seas when a Gilnean baron commands cutthroats on Kalimdor.
As a member of the Horde, you benefit when Southsea Freebooters near Ratchet are cleared out and the port stays open for Horde supplies moving into the Barrens.
As a member of the Alliance, you rely on neutral shipping between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, which Longshore's piracy disrupts.
